answer.rationale: p99 write-path latn 5× target, confined to primary region, onset within the window of a release shipped 2 h ago. memory_b1 documents that a prior rollback cleared a checkout-error spike without customer impact and that the prior build was stable; verifying it confirms the rollback path is well-practiced and lossless. memory_b6 supports the gating/canary discipline but the regression has already passed canary. settlement peak means we cannot afford prolonged degradation; rollback restores the known-good build fastest while preserving all in-flight writes. regional failover (memory_b2) addresses region-wide latency but does not remove the faulty build; add_capacity masks the symptom; circuit breaker would shed load (losing writes); routing to read replicas (memory_b5) does not help the write path.
